Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Acrobatics may not be used to dodge an additional strike, since you had to
have played an additional strike to get the chance of playing the Acrobatics
at all, and can't play multiple additional strike cards in a single round.
If the inferior version of Acrobatics was dodge rather than additional
strike, then you'd be ok.
